name: @sos-2/tests-accessibility
description: SOS 2.0 Accessibility + Negative-Case Dogfood Suites (Work Order P15, lane C): the fresh-user product proof + every P15 negative case, driven through USER-REACHABLE surfaces only. Fresh-user acceptance: the flagship §11 journey completes through the composed product surfaces (the P13-style composition over the merged public exports + the P11 local-companion reference runtime) — progress is visible as typed records with evidence (never raw agent transcripts), completion is evidence-gated (independent certification; the body never certifies itself), exact source/deployment revisions are linked, and all unresolved uncertainty is retained in plain terms. Negative cases (one suite per Work-Order bullet, the W17 discipline — each fault CONSTRUCTED, DETECTED/CONTAINED with a typed record, never a silent pass, never a crash, and the evidence graph stays queryable and truthful afterward): stale state, missing evidence, contradictory evidence, unknown/unavailable telemetry, expired authority, revoked authority, unsafe candidate, failed evaluation, body crash, task resume from checkpoint, failed rollback, demo/live-state confusion, cross-project access attempt, secret leakage attempt, budget exhaustion. Structural pins: zero external dependencies (workspace:* + the existing toolchain only), offline determinism (no ambient time/randomness/network/processes/timers in the owned sources outside the documented composition boundary), the repository's fixed vitest seed, run-to-run-identical results, and the lane Architecture Delta record validating against the frozen schema.
